title: Witness Voice and Collective Memory
goal: Recognise free indirect discourse in historical chronicles and read an essay on how cities remember vanished spaces.
grammar: Free indirect discourse in historical chronicles and memory essays

items: I can distinguish a witness's unquoted perspective in free indirect discourse from the historian's analytical voice.
I can recognise the tense and deictic cues that separate free indirect discourse from direct and reported speech.
I can read and analyse a C1 essay on urban demolition, archives and collective memory.
